balls.text: Arora goes big, and SRH finish with 216! Deshpande misses the yorker just outside off. Juicy full toss and Arora wallops it over deep mid wicket!
brilliant yorker. Within the tramlines, and dropping right on the crease line. Arora swings like a rusty gate and misses, unsurprisingly
another wide full toss. Another swish and miss, and the umpire has to stretch out his arms again

more confusion in the middle, and a run-out has finally occurred! Full toss wide outside off. Arora swings at it and misses. This time, Verma scampers down for the single, only to be sent back. Deshpande receives the throw from his keeper and under-arms it into the stumps, with Verma stranded!
well well! Nails the wide yorker. Verma, rather ambitiously and desperately, looks for the reverse lap. Chalks it into the off side

slower ball on a back of a length outside off. Verma has a wild slog at it and jams it off the inside edge into his thigh pad. Arora had hared down for the possibility of a run but Verma was staying put. Deshpande opted against throwing too
top comeback by the bowler. Right in the blockhole outside off. Verma late to get his bat down and the ball scrapes past the toe-end

that has flown to the fence like a tracer bullet! Sweeper cover only had a handful of yards to move to his right but still could not get there. Very full and very wide. Verma scorches it past extra cover!

full and wide outside off. Verma throws himself at it but does not make contact. Verma immediately reviews after being denied the wide. Verma has taken a step to the off side but the ball is still beyond the new guideline. Wide called after review again!
oh, where has this come from?! Back of a length outside off. Arora stands up tall and slaps the living daylights out of this one. Thumped over long off!
short, wide and climbing through. Arora has a waft at it but is late on the stroke. Swishes and misses
very full just outside off. Verma cannot get under it and jams it out towards long off

nicked and gone! Nitish's party is over, and Archer has another wicket! Seems like a slower ball, bashed into the track outside off. Nitish swings at it with abandon and gets a healthy edge that is gobbled up by Jurel. No celebration from Archer. An air of frustration if anything, and the ground turns silent again!
dug in short outside off and this skids through. Nitish thinks about playing at it initially before letting it go
very full outside off. Arora drills it past extra cover. The two is there for the taking but Nitish wants strike
another buffet ball, and Nitish feasts! 24 off the over too! Another gentle knee-high full toss on middle. Nitish gets under it and shovels it over deep backward square leg!

short and wide again, but this seems to be wider. Nitish jumps up into the air, swishes and misses. And Nitish has reviewed it. Might have a case too. On direction, that is. Nitish has taken a slight step across but the ball seems to be beyond the revised guideline too. Decision overturned. Wide called.
back of a length delivery wide outside off. Nitish tries to hit it too hard over the off side and shanks it back to the bowler
successive sixes, and Nitish is turning up the heat! Juicy full toss outside off. Nitish plants his front foot and smokes it over long on!
a crack off the bat, and the ball flies! That made such a pure noise. Back of a length outside off. Nitish stands up on his toes and clatters it over wide long on!
slower bumper wide outside off. Arora reaches out for it and drags it towards mid wicket
more runs off the edge! Short and wide outside off. Arora has an ungainly swipe at it and the ball hurtles off the outside edge past short third!
superb yorker to finish the over. Zones in on middle and off, and Arora jams it out towards deep point
another sizzling yorker on off. Arora gets his bat down but cannot do much with it. Clinks it back towards the bowler

is that a bump-ball? RR think it is a catch, and we go upstairs to find out! Low full toss just outside off. Arora tries to dig it out with an open bat face. Clearly bounced, says the third umpire, and on we go!
streaky! Banged in short just outside off. Arora has a half-hearted tug at it and the ball flies off the top edge over short fine leg!
excellent yorker on middle and leg. Nitish jams down on it in time and squeezes it out towards short fine leg
angled in on a length on the pads. Arora a touch late on the flick and the ball dribbles off the pad towards short fine leg
zipped in full outside off. Arora comes forward and drives with an open bat face towards deep point

straight to extra cover, and Deshpande's impressive IPL continues! Back of a length and hung up wide outside off. Klaasen has to reach out significantly but in that process, he cannot generate the power or the elevation he wants. Picks out Parag to perfection, and Klaasen is livid with himself as he storms off!
full toss just outside off. Nitish drills it back to the bowler, who gets something on it and takes the sting out of the stroke
this is a terrific hit! Half-tracker outside off and this is begging to be hit. Nitish obliges and whacks it over deep mid wicket!
full and wide outside off. Klaasen shuffles across his stumps and shovels it towards deep mid wicket
nails the wide ball. On a length and sneaking just inside the tramlines. Left alone but the wide is not called, rightly
short and wide outside off. Klaasen reaches out for it and slaps it towards long off
up, up and away! A real teaser for Bishnoi at long off. On a length outside off. Klaasen checks his shot a tad but still has enough to lift it beyond the fence!
oh! Slower ball on a length outside off. Klaasen skips down but is not aware of the slower ball. Wafts at it and is beaten
slanted across the batter outside off. Klaasen has an agricultural whoosh across the line and misses
back of a length on middle and off. Nitish gets up on his toes and works it towards long on. Initial call was for two but Klaasen was having none of it
back of a length outside off. Klaasen's bottom hand takes over too much and he drags it towards deep mid wicket
slower ball bashed half-way down outside off. Klaasen fetches it and flat-bats it to long off
shortish outside off. Nitish gets on top of the bounce and laces a square cut towards deep point
back of a length outside off. Nitish comes half forward and pushes it towards extra cover
back of a length outside off. Nitish wafts at it but only swishes at thin air first up

skewed straight up, and there is a slight collision. Catch taken eventually, though! Back of a length outside off. Kishan has a mow across the line and loses his shape completely. No distance at all on it. The bowler and the keeper both go for it. They bump into each other but Sandeep keeps his palms clasped around the ball. Another marvellous Kishan knock, but he has to go with more than six overs left in the innings!
short and wide again. Klaasen does lay bat on ball this time and cuts it towards deep cover
another wayward delivery. Well beyond the tramlines and Klaasen lets it go
slower ball on a length but too wide outside off. Klaasen misses his sweep and then sees the umpire indulge in some exercise
yours? Mine? No one's in the end! Banged in short just outside off. Kishan swats it between deep square leg and deep mid wicket. Jadeja and Ferreira look at each other and neither puts in a dive!
uff, this is stunning batting! Full on middle and leg. Kishan snaps his wrists into action and whips it to long on's left. Parag dives over it on the fence, and lets in the boundary!
this is a raging SRH party now! Full, wide and Kishan gives it the lot. The bat face is opened and Kishan carves it over backward point!
slower bumper on middle and off. Kishan shapes for the upper-cut but is deceived by the lack of pace. Not called a wide. Kishan was tempted to review initially but opted against it
darted in very full on middle and leg. Klaasen flicks it towards long on
smashed! Right in the slot on middle and off. Klaasen knows the fielder at mid off is up and he pops it over him comfortably!
short and wide outside off. Kishan reaches out for it and slaps it enough to long off's right for a couple of runs

has that trickled into the fence?! Shortish outside off. Klaasen hangs back and cuts it past backward point. Pretorius sprawls to his left but the parry off his hand might have kissed the cushion. Looks like he has done enough. No touching of the cushion, and Klaasen has to settle for three
Klaasen with another mighty hit! Floaty slot ball outside off and Klaasen will have this for breakfast, lunch and dinner. Clean swing through the line and he sends it soaring over long on!
back of a length just outside off. Skids off the surface and Klaasen, looking to lift it over extra cover off the back foot, is beaten for pace
fired in full just outside leg. Kishan brings out the reverse and drills it towards deep point
back of a length outside off. Klaasen sits deep in his crease and cloths it towards long off

Kishan is on a roll now! Length ball speared in wide outside off. Kishan has to reach out and swishes himself off his feet literally. Peels the outer cover off the ball and knifes it over backward point!
slower ball on a back of a length outside off. Kishan lunges at it and flat-bats it past extra cover. Calls for two and Klaasen hares back
this is some shot! Off-pace on a back of a length outside off. Kishan moves across, frees his arms and scythes it over backward point!
just enough to clear the fence! Dug in short on leg. Kishan gets his front hip out of the way and muscles it over deep mid wicket!
very wide outside off. Kishan happy to let it go and take the wide
zipped in full on the pads, and put away! Easy pickings for Kishan, especially with short fine leg in the ring. Kishan rolls his wrists and clips it behind square!
short and wide outside off. Kishan throws everything at it and chalks it off the toe-end towards the keeper
googly on a length outside off. Kishan looks to go downtown but slices across it a little more than he would have wanted. On the bounce to long off
fetch that one too, says Kishan! Fifty up for the SRH skipper, and his purple patch against RR continues. Slot ball on leg. Kishan gets down on one knee and pummels it over deep mid wicket!
short and wide outside off. Klaasen waits for it and cuts it powerfully towards sweeper cover
right out of the screws! Flighted into the slot outside off. Klaasen winds up, goes through the line and smacks it over long on!
googly on a back of a length outside off. Kishan hangs back and powers it to long off
back of a length on off. Klaasen jams it into the turf and the ball bounces up over the bowler, who can only parry it towards long off
back of a length delivery outside off. Klaasen reaches out and slaps it towards long off
back of a length outside off and this skips through. Klaasen has a wild swipe across the line and sees the ball whistle past his blade
length ball wide outside off. Kishan throws himself at it, quite literally, and drills it out to sweeper cover
going, going, gone! A bit of a drag-down on middle and leg. Kishan picks the slower ball and smears it over deep mid wicket!
length ball hung up wide outside off. Left alone by Kishan and called a wide. No wide review for now...
back of a length outside off. Seems like a slower one and Klaasen, sitting back in his crease, stabs it to long off
length ball hidden wide outside off. Kishan throws his hands at it and slices it uppishly towards sweeper cover
googly on a length on leg. Kishan stays back and knocks it to long off to keep strike
back of a length on off. The googly cramps Klaasen further and he hacks it towards deep mid wicket
googly on a back of a length outside off. Kishan reaches out for it and flays it towards deep point
dragged down outside off. Klaasen gives himself room before flat-batting it towards long off
shortish on the stumps. Kishan hops back and pulls it towards long on
googly on a length just outside off. Klaasen comes forward and drives it to long off
hung up on a length wide outside off. Klaasen reaches out for it and punches it towards sweeper cover

Head falls, and Parag's ploy to bring himself on has worked a charm! Slowed up on a length just outside leg. Head skips down but is cramped for room. Not to the pitch of the ball either, meaning that he gets no power on his lofted stroke. Chips it down Ferreira's throat, and RR continue to tighten the screws!
fired in full on off. Kishan plants his front foot and flicks it to long on
very round-arm and bowled from well behind the crease too. On a length on leg and Head, stepping down, jabs it to long on
angled in much fuller, just outside leg. Kishan skips down and squeezes it out towards long on
back of a length on leg. Head goes back and jabs it towards sweeper cover
back of a length on the pads. Head uses his wrists and tucks it towards deep mid wicket
up and over goes Head! Banged half-way down and plenty of width on offer too. Head jumps up into the air, frees his arms and slaps it over cover!
slower low full toss on middle and leg. Head backs away but has to then reach out. Plinks it to mid on
safe! Shortish on middle and leg. Kishan has a swipe at it and cloths it completely. Mistimes it so badly that it does not carry to deep mid wicket
Kishan on the charge! Length ball on leg stump. Kishan plants his front foot and whips it over mid wicket!
begins with a slower yorker outside off. Head jams down on it and digs it out towards deep point
length ball, following the batter outside leg. Head waits for the slower one and bunts it to mid off
slower ball on a back of a length on leg. Kishan too early into his swipe and heaves it towards deep backward square leg
up, up and away! Right in the slot just outside off. Kishan plants his front foot, goes through the line and pumps it into the sightscreen!
slanted in full on middle and leg. Kishan gives himself room and muscles it over the bowler's head. Ferreira with a parry via his right hand this time. Saves two again
top work on the fence. Shortish on leg. Kishan backs away and hoicks it towards long on. Ferreira runs around to his left and parries it into play with his left hand
on a length outside off. Kishan presses half forward and pushes it into the off side
back of a length outside off. Head hangs back and cuts it straight to cover. He is livid with himself for not finding the gap
oh! Back of a length on off. Head gives himself ample room and looks to swish it over cover. Only grabs a handful of fresh air. Not far from the stumps either
shortish again, outside off. Kishan gets on top of the bounce and guides it towards deep backward point
short, wide, and just over! Right where Kishan wants it. He sits deep in his crease, throws his hands at it and carves it beyond deep backward point!

oh, this has gone a mile up, and the increase in decibel level as the ball falls tells you this has landed safely! Length on the stumps. Head backs away and swings for the hills. Miscues it but gets enough to clear Archer running back from mid on

edged and just past Jurel! Back of a length, following the batter just outside leg. Head pokes at it and the ball grazes the inside edge. Jurel sprawls to his right, gets a fingertip to it but cannot do much else!
shortish just outside off. Kishan tries to force it through the off side but ends up chunking it back to the bowler
back of a length just outside off. Kishan hangs back and dabs it towards backward point
haul that back from the stands! Marginally short on middle and leg. Sits up and Kishan picks it up to dump it over deep mid wicket!
hard length, on leg stump. Kishan takes a step down the track but the lack of room means he punches it straight to cover point
Kishan is up and running too! Hard length again but the line is the problem. Straying onto the hips and Kishan helps it over short fine leg!
back of a length on the stumps. No room to work with and Kishan, hopping up onto his toes, plays it down the ground
zipped in fuller on middle and off. Head backs away a touch before jamming it out towards extra cover
back of a length on middle and off, shaping away a touch. Head stays leg side of the ball and jabs it towards mid off
fetch that, says Head! There is no wait-and-watch gear to Head's batting. Picks up this length ball on off, backs away and flays it over extra cover!
dug in short on middle and leg. Head opens up his stance and hacks across the line. Only connects with fresh air
hard length, nipping back into middle and leg. Head tries to give himself room but is hurried on the stroke. Stabbed into the off side
shortish and tucking up the batter near the hips. Head is cramped up and the ball pings off the thigh pad towards short fine leg
back of a length on middle and leg. Kishan gets behind the line, covers the away movement and pats it gently into the off side
oh! Brutish delivery, on a back of a length on off and this rears up. Kishan has a fend at it and prods it towards backward point
safe! Length ball on the pads and this seems to just stick a little. Kishan has a swish at it and clinks it off the toe-end. Just clears mid on running to his left
back of a length on middle and leg. Swerves away late and Kishan gets a half stride in to defend it into the off side
on a length on off and this zings away a great deal. Kishan comes forward and lets it go

oh, hello, and goodbye! Abhishek goes after it first-ball, and Abhishek bites the dust! Banged in on middle and leg. Nips away a touch and Abhishek hares down the track. Throws the kitchen sink at it but only manages a slice. The ball lobs a mile up and Bishnoi does the rest at deep backward point. Stunned silence in Hyderabad!

sliced to extra cover, and that will be that for the RR juggernaut! The streak has been broken, and two unheralded, uncapped debutants have brought the Royals crashing down to earth! Full toss on middle and leg. Deshpande has a swing at it and does not get any of it. Kishan is stationed at extra cover to complete the formality, and that is confirmation of a statement win for SRH in front of their fans!
hard length on off. Burger hangs back and stabs it towards long on
into the blockhole again, just outside off. Clinked out towards deep backward square leg
shortish outside off. Deshpande has a wild hack at it and misses
back of a length on off. Burger gives himself a bit of room and jabs it towards sweeper cover
top yorker on middle and off. Burger does well to get his bat down and keep it out

this is a mighty hit! Hinge's debut began sweetly, and ends with a bit of a sour taste. But it will not matter in the grander scheme, and will take nothing away from a sensational display otherwise. Shortish outside off and Deshpande pummels it over deep mid wicket!
into the blockhole on middle and leg. Deshpande jams down on it and squeezes it out towards deep mid wicket. Back for a brace
back of a length on middle and off. Burger lets the ball come to him before bunting it into the wide mid on region
banged in short outside off. Burger looks to dab at it but fails to lay bat on ball. Beaten by the lack of pace perhaps
low full toss just outside off. Deshpande has a hoick at it and squirts it off the inside edge towards deep backward square leg
smoked over deep mid wicket! Dragged down outside off. Deshpande spots the length early and wallops it over deep mid wicket!

this goes a mile up, and Sakib has four too! What a night to be a debutant. What a night to be an SRH fan! Off-pace on a length outside off. Bishnoi goes for broke without gauging what Sakib is doing. A massive miscue and Kishan, running in from extra cover, snaffles it up. RR nine down, and the two debutants (Hinge and Sakib) have combined for eight wickets!

popped tamely to short third, and Sakib's slower ball is causing all sorts of problems! Another dipping delivery, on a fullish length outside off. Archer shapes for the reverse-ramp but has no pace to work with. Simple pop off the bat and Hinge, Sakib's fellow debutant, hands the latter his third wicket!
slower ball, pitching on a back of a length on middle and spinning down leg. Easy decision for the umpire
full on middle and off. Deshpande winds up and tugs it on the bounce to long on
pace-on this time, low full toss outside off. Archer digs it out towards extra cover, and Deshpande scampers through for the single
slower ball on a length outside off. Dips on Archer late and he has no clue about it. Swings at least a week early and misses
pin-point yorker outside off. Archer cannot get his bat down in time and the ball squirms past the toe-end of his bat
Deshpande with a clean strike! Slower ball that lands right in the slot on middle and off. Deshpande goes through the line and hoists it over the sightscreen!
low full toss just outside off. Deshpande gets under it and drop-kicks it towards long on. Opens his account with a brace
sharp short ball on middle and leg. Deshpande jumps around his crease before fending it towards the bowler

has Jadeja nicked it?! SRH think so but the umpire is unmoved! SRH go upstairs! Shortish just outside off and this zips through. Jadeja shapes for the cut but is cramped for room. There seemed to be a noise in real-time as the ball passed the bat. And UltraEdge confirms it. A clear spike off the toe-end, and Jadeja has to go back to the shed!
low full toss on the stumps. Archer tugs it down the ground to long on
off-pace and into the track outside off. Jadeja tries to hit it too hard and scuffs it into the off side

does him all ends up, and Ferreira is outta here! Beautifully-disguised slower ball, pitching on a back of a length just outside off snd decking in. Ferreira has no clue about it and has an ungainly swipe across the line. Misses it completely and hears the rattling of his stumps soon after. RR six down now!
miscued but safe! Off-pace and into the track outside off. Ferreira has a wild mow at it and mistimes it. Goes straight up and the bowler, running back, cannot quite get there
serious power! Length ball outside off. Ferreira gives it all he has and thunders it between extra cover and long off!
sizzling yorker outside off, bowled at 134kph. Ferreira is late on the inside-out lofted stroke and misses
oh! Slower ball on a back of a length outside off. Cuts back in and Ferreira, heaving at it, misses. Awfully close to off stump too!
into the blockhole outside off. Jadeja jams down on it and clinks it back past the bowler
full toss on the pads but Jadeja cannot put it away. Flicks it straight to deep backward square leg
short, wide and punished! Quite slow too, meaning Jadeja has the time to line it up. Extends his arms and swats it past extra cover!
slower bumper outside off. Jadeja lets it go and the umpire calls it a wide on height
low full toss just outside off. Jadeja flicks it towards deep mid wicket
back of a length outside off. Ferreira reaches out for it and shanks it towards long off
slower ball on a back of a length outside off. Jadeja scuffs it down the ground
searing yorker, tailing into leg stump. Ferreira seems to miss it, with the ball rolling away off the back leg behind square. Might have been doing too much
Full and outside off, heaved to deep square leg. Brings up the 100 partnership

Oh, oh, oh! Overthrows and Kishan is not pleased. Low full toss outside off, pinged to short cover, who has a shy at the bowler's end seeing Jadeja out of the crease. The backing up in the deep on the opposite side is not great. Malinga lets it through
On a length outside off, it is the slower one. He swings across the line but only makes contact with thin air
Direct hit but is Jadeja in? Chops a length ball towards backward point and sets off. He is sent back early and makes it in. They eventually take a run off the deflection

Short and outside off, pulled through midwicket. My word, the timing is such that the deep midwicket fielder couldn't rein it in. Sakib ran a fair distance, diuved full length but could only parry it away
Floaty full ball outside off, driven to sweeper cover
Quicker and full just outside off, driven back to the bowler. 14 runs and three dots from the over
Quicker and on a length wide outside off, cut to backward point
Humongous! This is out of Hyderabad. Slot ball outside off, Ferreira clears his front leg and launches it wayyyy over long-on
Back-to-back fours bring up a maiden half-century in the IPL for Ferreira. Short and outside off again, he goes deep in the crease and slaps it through forward point
Short and outside off, once again Ferreia has a lot of time to go back and pull it through midwicket
Shortish outside off, goes back to cut but misses because of the extra bounce
Shortish outside off, quicker, though. Quickly brings his bat down to pull it to long-on, 13 from the over
Finds the gap in the deep, Ferreira! It is the googly again but it is short around off and middle. Ample time for him to go back and pull it through midwicket
Floated full outside off, Jadeja powers it staight down. Long-off gets around, slides and keeps it to one
Full on off, drilled down to long-off
Huge! Makes superb contact. Tossed up full on off, he clears his front leg and tonks it high over long-off
Tossed up outside off, he swings hard but misses. Was the googly that he did not pick
slowed up on a length outside off. Ferreira reaches out for it and slaps it towards sweeper cover
into the blockhole just outside off. Jadeja jams it out towards long on
into the blockhole on middle and leg. Jadeja tucks it off his toes towards deep square leg
back of a length delivery well outside off. Seemed to be beyond the tramlines. Jadeja left it and got the wide too
back of a length outside off. Skids through and Jadeja dabs it into the off side
shortish outside off. Ferreira gets onto the back foot and slaps it towards sweeper cover
googly on a back of a length on off. Jadeja hangs back and punches it towards long off
short and wide outside off. Jadeja swishes at it and misses. Called a wide
back of a length on middle and off. Jadeja drops it into the on side and calls for the run. Ferreira has to scramble but makes it, despite the keeper's close attention
dragged down just outside off. Ferreira hacks it towards long on
googly floated up full outside off. Jadeja reaches out for it and drags it towards long on
leg-spinner on a back of a length outside off. Dabbed towards backward point
shortish again, outside off. Ferreira hops back and cuts it towards sweeper cover
googly on a back of a length outside off. Ferreira goes back and punches it straight to extra cover
slanted in on a length on off. Ferreira comes forward and taps it towards deep mid wicket
full and wide outside off. Ferreira throws his hands at it and drills it towards sweeper cover
hard length just outside off and this gets a little big on Ferreira. Prodded back to the bowler
back of a length just outside off. Jadeja tips it to mid off and scampers across to the other end
length outside off. Jadeja gets a half stride in and pokes it towards mid off
back of a length just outside off. Jadeja dinks it to the edge of the ring in the mid wicket region, and both batters dash back for two
length ball hung up wide outside off. Jadeja lets it go and the umpire signals for a wide
makes no difference! On the shorter side again. Wide outside off and Ferreira, throwing the lot at it, slices it over short third!
shot! Another drag-down. A googly that finishes outside off and Ferreira uses the depth of the crease to pound it to long on's right!
googly dropped short outside off. Ferreira hangs back and slaps it past extra cover for a couple of runs
dragged down outside off. Ferreira hops back and hacks it towards the bowler
shortish outside off. Jadeja hops back and cuts it towards sweeper cover
rapped on the pad, but that might have been sliding down leg! Googly on a length on off. Spins back in and traps Jadeja on the back leg. Might have done too much
slower ball on a length on leg. Jadeja tucks it off his pads towards deep backward square leg

low full toss outside off. Ferreira plants his front foot and drills it back at the bowler. Might have been a chance but Malinga could not get a boot in the way. Not even the boot. That clocked Malinga on the shin!
back of a lenght, zoning into off. Jadeja bunts it to the edge of the ring in the mid wicket region. Settles for a single
Jadeja counter-punches again! Right in the slot outside off. Jadeja transfers his weight forward and pumps it over mid off!
shortish on the hips. Ferreira swivels and pulls it towards long leg

big lbw shout, and Malinga is adamant he has his man! SRH review! Back of a length in the channel and this decks back in sharply. Ferreira, caught on the crease, gets pinned on the back leg. Might be a touch high, but SRH want to try their luck. No bat involved but Ball Tracking has the ball sailing over off stump. Ferreira stays!
back of a length on off. Ferreira lets the ball come to him before stabbing it into the mid wicket region. That was bowled at 135.2kph
up and over again! Length ball outside off and Ferreira takes full toll. He gets forward and bangs it over mid off!
back of a length outside off. Ferreira gets up on his toes and hacks it towards mid on
boshed! On a length and laced with width. Ferreira says thank you very much. Steps forward and crashes it over cover!
short and wide outside off. Ferreira tries to hit it too hard and scuffs it towards mid off
length outside off, with a hint of shape away. Ferreira gets onto the front foot and defends
sharp bumper but this slides down leg. Ferreira gets inside the line and leaves it alone. That was bowled at a tick under 131 kph!
four more! Drifts onto the pads and Jadeja takes advantage. Rolls his wrists to this back of a length ball, and helps it past short fine leg!
back of a length just outside off. Jadeja gets up on his toes and plays it back to the bowler
bumper outside off but this sails through without causing much trouble. Left alone and called a wide on height
Jadeja lands his first blow! Shortish on middle and leg. Jadeja rises with the bounce and hammers it between square leg and mid wicket!
safe! Full and angled into middle and off. Ferreira gets turned inside out and plonks it off the leading edge over the bowler
back of a length, honing into off and hitting the bat hard. Ferreira defends into the off side
mix-up but no damage done! Back of a length on the stumps. Jadeja turns it to mid wicket and sets off. Ferreira late to respond but does enough to make it. Last thing RR need is a run-out...

slashed to slip, and Hinge's day of days keeps getting better! Full, wide and enticing the drive away from the body. Parag cannot fight the urge to have a pop at it and gets a thick outside edge that nestles into slip's palms. Hinge has four. SRH has five. And RR are on the mat!
just in the gap! Back of a length on middle and leg. Parag stands tall and with a wave of his willow, razes it between mid on and mid wicket!
on a length just outside off. Parag gets a half stride in before patting it into the off side
back of a length, angling into off. Parag lets the ball come to him before meeting it right under his eyes. This was bowled at 137.2kph
back of a length delivery outside off. Parag happy to let it goe
short and wide outside off. Flies through harmlessly and called a wide
Back of a length outside off. Parag, rather ambitiously, looks to upper-cut it but fails to lay bat on ball
back of a length on middle and off. Jadeja gets up on his toes and works it into the deep square leg region. Opens his account with a brace
length ball hung up wide outside off. Jadeja reaches out for it and jabs it towards point

plonked to deep backward point, and RR are falling apart like a deck of cards! This is banged half-way down. Gets up very high but Jaiswal still tries to carve it over point. Off the bottom half of the bat and like Pretorius earlier, he could not have picked out the sweeper better. RR in all sorts, and that is probably putting it mildly!
short and wide again. Jaiswal has another pop at it and while he does make some contact, he cannot quite get it past backward point
short and wide outside off. Jaiswal goes chasing after it and misses it completely
short and wide outside off. Jaiswal throws his hands at it and cuts it towards backward point
back of a length on middle and leg. Jaiswal gets up on his toes and stabs it into the off side

three in the over! Goodness gracious me - you cannot write this script! Hinge has arrived on the IPL scene, and he is making this his stage! Full on the pads. Pretorius looks to help it on its way but he can only find the sweeper at deep backward square leg. Hinge cannot believe what he has just done. This is fantasy and then some. RR three down in the first over, and SRH are all over them like a rash!
my word! Serious wheels from Hinge. On a back of a length outside off. Skips off the surface and Pretorius, nibbling at it, sees the ball whistle past the outside edge

chopped on, and this is a debut from beyond his wildest dreams! Hinge, who had never bowled in the IPL before, now has two wickets in four balls. Easy game, ain't it? Back of a length outside off. Jurel has a tentative poke at it and the ball cannons off the inside edge into his stumps. Hinge is off on a celebratory run, and RR have been rocked twice in succession!
full and wide outside off. Jurel reaches out for it and pokes it towards cover point

goes straight up, and Hinge has outwitted the 15-year-old! What a dream start for Hinge. His first game in the IPL. And he bashes this into the track on middle and leg. Sooryavanshi looks to swipe it over cow corner but the ball gets big on him. Off the top edge and Arora snares the chance with minimal fuss. SRH in dreamland, and Hinge, hailing from Nagpur, has left his mark on the IPL off just his second ball!
back of a length outside off. Jaiswal rides the bounce and runs it down a little uppishly towards deep third
